verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers formation document generation (Document Driver), dilution and liquidation calculators, and a SAFE guide. None of these items mentions founder vesting schedules, 83(b) elections, or co-founder equity splits. The ERISA/executive compensation page covers equity-based compensation advice such as stock options and stock purchases, but that is an adjacent practice offering, not first-party founder equity materials.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
